motd:
Season 0: Tingen

Choose Standard for Beyonder Shaders (shadows, red moonlight, gaslight and fog) or Lite for older computers. Press V to open your Spirit Vision.

news.title: Arms and equipment
news.body:
Pack 0.11.0 brings a new inventory. Clothing has its own slots under your armour (and a button to show your clothes over it), and there are slots for your main weapon, an ammo pouch, rings, an amulet, a charm, a worn Sealed Artifact and a three-slot potion belt (Z, B and N drink or eat from it).

Weapons now work only from the weapon slot: press X to draw or sheathe, and C to swap your main weapon with your sidearm, which also serves as your off hand. Put away, swords hang at your hip, revolvers sit in a holster and heavy weapons ride on your back.

New animations: drawing and sheathing, a combat stance for each kind of weapon, three-step attack combos, gun recoil and reloading, and poses for casting abilities and divining.

Potions digest more slowly, and acting the same way again and again counts for less, so a Sequence takes real time to master.

Also new: Lithium, FerriteCore, Dynamic FPS, Simple Voice Chat, Controlling and Cubes Without Borders in every edition; Distant Horizons, Sound Physics Remastered, AmbientSounds, Ambient Environment, Particular and Interactive Foliage in Standard.

news.title: Who are you in Tingen?
news.body:
Pack 0.10.0 brings character creation. The first time you join, choose a name, a look (skin tone, eyes, brows, hair, facial hair, build and clothes) and a background: History Graduate, Dock Worker, Constable, Apothecary's Apprentice, Street Urchin or Heir of a Faded House. Each gives a small perk and something to start with.

Your character's name is what others see above your head and in chat. Look straight at someone to see their account name underneath.

news.title: An armoury for Tingen
news.body:
Pack 0.9.0 adds a longsword, a gentleman's sword cane (use it to draw the hidden blade), a crimson greatsword whose cuts fester, and a crescent staff that helps a Seer gather Spirituality. The revolver is slimmer and smaller on screen.

And a Sealed Artifact: Death Knell, an iron-black long-barrelled revolver. Every shot finds a weakness, and a bell tolls with it. It takes its price from you.

news.title: A proper revolver, and brewing by hand
news.body:
Pack 0.8.0 rebuilds the revolver as a 3D gun: hold right click to aim down the sights, left click to fire, R to reload. Hip fire scatters, aimed shots land, headshots hurt.

Brewing is now a minigame at the Apothecary Bench: work the bellows to keep the heat steady, drop each ingredient in on time, and don't crack the flask. Better brews make better potions, and a Perfect potion is far safer to drink before you've digested the last one. Every item has also been redrawn.

news.title: Brewing, coins and revolvers
news.body:
Pack 0.7.0 brings the Apothecary Bench: hold a potion formula, bring a water bottle and the ingredients, and brew your own Seer, Clown or Magician potion. Ingredients come from the wild at night and from the creatures you defeat; witches sometimes carry a formula.

Tingen now has money: copper pence, silver soli and gold pounds. A Seer can flip a soli to ask whether danger is near. Also new: a six-shot revolver with silver rounds for the undead, slate roofs, plaster walls and iron railings.

news.title: Launcher 0.1.4: Minecraft sign-in fix
news.body: Signing in with Microsoft now asks for the right Xbox permissions, so the code page and the Minecraft step stop refusing the launcher. If an account shows an error, remove it in Settings › Accounts and add it again.

news.title: The ability wheel and potion visions
news.body: Hold G to open the ability wheel and pick a power or your Spirit Vision. Drinking a potion now brings a vision: the cold, the twisting world, the whispers, and the flash when it takes hold. Builders can raise row houses, shops, a chapel and a whole Tingen street.

news.title: Clowns, Magicians and crimson nights
news.body: Sequence 8 and 7 powers: Card Throw, Air Bullet, Flame Jump, Paper Substitute and Acrobatics (G to select, R to use). Full-moon nights turn crimson, soot drifts through the streets, church bells toll, chimneys smoke and the sun is round. Pendulum markers now stand on the surface.

news.title: The Seer pathway
news.body: Seer, Clown and Magician potions, Spirituality, digestion through acting, and loss of control. Divine with the Spirit Pendulum: rename it to ask a question and follow the spirit marker it leaves.

news.title: Beyonder Shaders and Spirit Vision halos
news.body: The Standard edition now ships our own shader pack: soft shadows, red moonlight, flickering gaslight, coal-smoke fog and lamp glow. Spirit Vision shows animated halos around players and creatures that grow brighter and change colour with their strength, and spirit markers for waypoints.

news.title: Tingen at Night
news.body: The first Beyonder mod build is in the pack: a muted Victorian color grade, thick night fog under a red moon, gas lamps and Tingen street blocks, and the Seer's Spirit Vision (press V).

editions.name: Standard
editions.description: Beyonder Shaders (soft shadows, red moonlight, flickering gaslight, coal-smoke fog, lamp glow) plus Distant Horizons, sound physics and ambient sounds, Ambient Environment, Particular particles and Interactive Foliage. Needs a dedicated graphics card.

editions.name: Lite
editions.description: The core game with the performance mods (Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, Dynamic FPS) and voice chat; no shaders or extra visual and sound mods. The Tingen color grade, fog and Spirit Vision still apply. Runs on most computers.
